verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is an API-first service. It has official SDKs in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Ruby and Rust, bearer API tokens, and async/blocking operation handling, so it runs headlessly by design. Its docs also give testing guidance for isolated per-test namespaces, which suits CI automation. Missing for 10: no dedicated CLI or CI-integration guide, API tokens are created only in the dashboard, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can create and expire tokens in the dashboard.
The official client libraries handle this automatically and transparently — the call will block until the operation finishes.
Send the `Prefer: respond-async` header to allow the server to start the operation in the background.
